+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from lib import fantasypros
+from lib.source_data import SourceCache, SourcePolicy
+
+
+class FantasyProsCallLogTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_live_attempts_and_daily_summary_are_append_only_and_secret_free(self):
+        rate_limited = Mock(status_code=429)
+        successful = Mock(status_code=200)
+        successful.json.return_value = {"players": [{"mflid": "1002"}]}
+
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            log_path = Path(temp_dir) / "fantasypros-calls.jsonl"
+            cache = SourceCache(Path(temp_dir) / "cache")
+            with (
+                patch.dict(
+                    os.environ,
+                    {
+                        fantasypros.CALL_LOG_ENV: str(log_path),
+                        fantasypros.RUN_DATE_ENV: "2026-09-18",
+                    },
+                    clear=False,
+                ),
+                patch("lib.fantasypros.requests.get", side_effect=[rate_limited, successful]) as get,
+                patch("lib.fantasypros._api_key", return_value="fixture-secret"),
+                patch("lib.fantasypros.time.sleep"),
+            ):
+                response = fantasypros.fetch_projection_response(
+                    2026,
+                    "QB",
+                    horizon="week",
+                    week=2,
+                    policy=SourcePolicy(refresh=True),
+                    cache=cache,
+                )
+            summary = fantasypros.write_daily_call_summary(
+                path=log_path,
+                summary_date="2026-09-18",
+            )
+
+            log_text = log_path.read_text()
+            records = [json.loads(line) for line in log_text.splitlines()]
+
+        self.assertEqual(response.payload, {"players": [{"mflid": "1002"}]})
+        self.assertEqual(get.call_count, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [record["record_type"] for record in records],
+            ["attempt", "attempt", "daily_summary"],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [
+                (record["status"], record["outcome"], record["attempt"])
+                for record in records[:2]
+            ],
+            [(429, "rate_limited", 1), (200, "success", 2)],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {
+                record["endpoint"]
+                for record in records[:2]
+            },
+            {"projections/QB"},
+        )
+        self.assertEqual({record["week"] for record in records[:2]}, {2})
+        self.assertEqual(
+            summary,
+            {
+                "record_type": "daily_summary",
+                "timestamp": summary["timestamp"],
+                "date": "2026-09-18",
+                "provider": "FantasyPros",
+                "attempts": 2,
+                "successful_requests": 1,
+                "rate_limited_attempts": 1,
+                "failed_attempts": 0,
+            },
+        )
+        self.assertNotIn("fixture-secret", log_text)
+
+    def test_transport_failures_log_statusless_attempts_without_error_text(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
+            log_path = Path(temp_dir) / "fantasypros-calls.jsonl"
+            with (
+                patch.dict(
+                    os.environ,
+                    {
+                        fantasypros.CALL_LOG_ENV: str(log_path),
+                        fantasypros.RUN_DATE_ENV: "2026-09-18",
+                    },
+                    clear=False,
+                ),
+                patch(
+                    "lib.fantasypros.requests.get",
+                    side_effect=RuntimeError("secret endpoint and token"),
+                ),
+                patch("lib.fantasypros._api_key", return_value="fixture-secret"),
+                patch("lib.fantasypros.time.sleep"),
+            ):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "FantasyPros fetch failed"):
+                    fantasypros.fetch_projection_response(
+                        2026,
+                        "RB",
+                        horizon="season_total",
+                        policy=SourcePolicy(refresh=True),
+                        cache=SourceCache(Path(temp_dir) / "cache"),
+                    )
+
+            log_text = log_path.read_text()
+            records = [json.loads(line) for line in log_text.splitlines()]
+
+        self.assertEqual(len(records), fantasypros.MAX_ATTEMPTS)
+        self.assertTrue(all(record["status"] is None for record in records))
+        self.assertTrue(all(record["outcome"] == "error" for record in records))
+        self.assertTrue(all(record["error_type"] == "RuntimeError" for record in records))
+        self.assertNotIn("secret endpoint and token", log_text)
+        self.assertNotIn("fixture-secret", log_text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

ticket.body:
Parent: #232.

What: add an append-only local counter log for every live FantasyPros request in the snapshot run: one line per attempt with timestamp, endpoint or position and week, HTTP status, and attempt count, plus one per-day summary line. Keep it local and owner-neutral; log no key material, tokens, or .env contents. Independent of the fast-path abort logic; uses only request metadata already available at the call site.

Accept: a day with mixed outcomes shows one log entry per live attempt with outcome and attempt count plus the daily summary, and a grep of the log and summary shows no secret material.

Risk: standard
